title: NormalizedCall v1
description: What a Guardian Angel client adapter sends the service for a tool call that System 0 escalated. Every field is computed on the principal's machine; the service verifies nothing it cannot see. Strings are redacted and clipped at the edge (redact.js) and re-redacted on ingest.

harness.description: Which runtime produced the call: claude-code | codex | gemini-cli | trial | …

core_sha.description: conscience-research commit the client's System 0 and context code were vendored from

call_id.description: sha256(tool_name + canonical tool_input), first 16 hex chars. Lets a principal's approval be matched to the exact call.

principal_request.description: The most recent instruction the principal typed

output.description: Start of what the call printed. Untrusted environment data.

reflex_flags.description: What System 0 noticed but could not decide on

file_meta.description: For Write/Edit: version-control facts about the target

write_targets.description: For Bash: files the command would overwrite or destroy

referenced_files.description: Scripts the command would run, resolved locally (DAG flattening). Path may carry an annotation such as ' (heredoc)'.

unresolved_files.description: Scripts the command would run whose contents could not be read
